record.question: Hindu Marriage Bill approved in 2016 in which country?
record.explanation: Answer B: Pakistan. Pakistan is the country of the Hindu Marriage Bill 2016. Its National Assembly legislative records identify the bill and its parliamentary passage; final federal enactment followed in 2017, so bill approval in 2016 must not be described as final enactment that year. Historical/source note: Pakistan; a 2016 bill-stage event, with final federal Act in 2017. Do not conflate with older laws elsewhere or provincial Sindh legislation. Reference: https://na.gov.pk/uploads/documents/1489061090_495.pdf; https://na.gov.pk/en/search_content.php. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
